title: Wings live: Hard Rock Cafe, London | 1973
content:
Wings performed their first London show on 18 March 1973, at the Hard Rock Cafe in London.

They had agreed to take part in the Charity Brawl, a fundraiser for Release, the organisation providing legal assistance for people charged with drug possession.

Embed from Getty Images

Wings were billed as “Mystery Star”, and the event organisers were unsure if they would play. Also on the bill were Brinsley Schwarz. Tickets cost £5, and around £1,500 was raised for the charity.

Wings took to the stage at around 12.45am on the morning of 19 March, and played until 1.30am.

Embed from Getty Images
